diagnoses.description:
The pipeline enforces at most one P and one S per file. The task explicitly allows multiple picks per phase, so this may cap recall on files with legitimate multi-arrival events. However, since the gt is per-station traces, one pick each is likely appropriate for most cases.
Evidence: Physics-based constraints (EVENT_WIN=(3000,9000), MAX_SP_GAP=800) reduced picks from 171 to 110 and later constraints kept "single best P/S per file" only.
Trajectory location: Turns 27-30 (window/gap constraints before the channel fix)

Some traces are very low SNR or have unusual channels; the ensemble didn't clear thresholds. Given task tolerance is F1≥0.7 P / ≥0.6 S, missing ~5–20 picks per phase may still pass if the accepted picks are accurate.
Evidence: 5 files still have no picks; 6 files have only P, 14 have only S.
Trajectory location: Turn 40 final state

The benchmark does not expose ground truth; the agent had to rely on physical plausibility as a proxy. Actual F1 is unknown.
Evidence: No pick was ever validated against ground truth — the agent never accessed a ground-truth file or grader.
Trajectory location: Whole run

location_policy: native trajectory locations retained in description; no inferred Skill location
